results.title: EU sanctions Myanmar, Germany condemns 'murders'
results.snippet: The European Union has now followed the United States, Britain, and Canada in targeting Myanmar's military with sanctions on assets and foreign travel.

results.title: Myanmar: Is the US undermining the EU's diplomatic blockade?
results.snippet:
Its sanctions currently cover 105 individuals and 22 entities connected to the military. In April, the EU extended these measures for another 12 months.

At the same time, Brussels is providing humanitarian assistance to displaced communities and Rohingya refugees and is supporting civil society organizations.
